scope: Reviewed email and username claims only; not full corpus reconciliation.

rows.requirement: Record email linkage separately from exclusive verified association, account type and IdP identity. Shared unverified linkage is documented, but generic uniqueness wording remains unresolved for exact product/account combinations.
rows.negative_test: An unverified re-added address cannot certify verified ownership; uniqueness prose cannot alone disprove documented shared linkage.

rows.requirement: Use exact operation, product/version, account cohort and observed verification state; preserve explicit unavailable operations alongside broad most-actions prose. Independently verify managed-user exceptions and do not derive a universal pass from successful IdP login.
rows.negative_test: IdP login or account existence cannot prove PAT generation, OAuth authorization, invitation acceptance or Actions capability.

rows.requirement: Distinguish resend request, actual delivery, correct account session, unexpired link and confirmed target address state; redact links/tokens and bind evidence to stable account identity. FPT/GHEC procedure does not provide a GHES implementation.
rows.negative_test: A sent-mail record, source screenshot, wrong-account session or expired 24-hour link cannot pass verification.

rows.requirement: For the cloud restriction scenario require approved address change/removal, valid nondisposable address verification and separate support review outcome. Preserve recovery impact and custody before mutation; noreply is not a valid-account-email substitute.
rows.negative_test: Changing primary address cannot prove restriction lifted or support accepted; noreply cannot waive account email requirements.

rows.requirement: Bind organization approved-domain restriction, actual verified recipient address, placeholder handling and observed delivery separately. Delivery evidence is not policy enforcement or rights clearance.
rows.negative_test: Verified address outside the approved domain or placeholder API identity cannot establish organization email delivery.

rows.requirement: Track creation/privacy timing and actual noreply format, historical attribution, current commit settings and signature status independently. Boundary dates and unelaborated combinations remain unknown until verified.
rows.negative_test: Numeric-ID attribution retention cannot certify retained Verified status; current privacy toggle cannot rewrite old commits.

limitations: Negative-test entries are specifications, not implemented or executed tests.
No account mutation, credential changes, legal clearance or native activation.
Claim identity verification is not independent semantic equivalence or omission certification.
